- Vat.Rate → extract percentage without % sign: 20.
- Net.Amount → 233,15 → 233.15 (number), preserve two decimals.
- Vat.Amount → 46,63 → 46.63 (number), preserve two decimals.
- Invoice.Date and Sender.VatId are strings as found.

5) No inference beyond visible data
- All extracted values are explicitly present; no guessing required.

- GrandTotal.Amount = 279.78
- Invoice.Date = "25.01.2024"
- Sender.VatId = "ATU49325305"
- Vat.Rate = 20
- Net.Amount = 233.15
